description: This file defines a PHP class ADODB2_postgres that extends the ADODB_DataDict class to implement PostgreSQL-specific Data Dictionary operations such as creating, altering, dropping columns and tables, managing indexes, and handling sequences within the ADODB PHP database abstraction library.

classes.name: ADODB2_postgres
classes.description: A class providing PostgreSQL-specific implementations of data dictionary operations for the ADODB PHP library, including table and column modifications, index management, and sequence handling.

methods.name: metaType
methods.description: Maps generic data types to PostgreSQL-specific internal types based on input type, length, and object properties.

methods.name: actualType
methods.description: Returns the standard PostgreSQL data type corresponding to a given internal type code.

methods.name: addColumnSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL statements to add new columns to a table, handling default values and null constraints appropriately for PostgreSQL.

methods.name: dropIndexSQL
methods.description: Creates SQL to drop an index, given its name and associated table.

methods.name: alterColumnSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL statements to alter the definition of a column, including data type changes, default values, and null constraints, taking into account PostgreSQL version compatibility.

methods.name: dropColumnSQL
methods.description: Produces SQL to drop a column from a table, using PostgreSQL-specific capabilities depending on version.

methods.name: _recreate_copy_table
methods.description: Handles complex table alteration by copying data to a temporary table, dropping the original, recreating with new schema, and copying data back, including sequence handling.

methods.name: dropTableSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL to drop a table and associated sequences if necessary.

methods.name: _createSuffix
methods.description: Constructs SQL suffix for column definitions, handling auto-increment, defaults, nullability, and constraints.

methods.name: _dropAutoIncrement
methods.description: Finds and drops auto-increment sequences associated with a table if they exist.

methods.name: renameTableSQL
methods.description: Creates SQL to rename a table, considering schema context.

methods.name: _indexSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL to create or replace indexes, supporting unique, hash, and other options.

methods.name: _getSize
methods.description: Determines the data type string with size and precision specifications.

methods.name: changeTableSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL statements for comprehensive table schema modifications, including adding, altering, and dropping columns.
